items.abstract: Hardware-agnostic machine learning infrastructure for .NET. Implements high-performance neural network layers in C# that are transpiled to run on WebGPU, CUDA, OpenCL, WebGL, CPU, and Wasm via SpawnDev.ILGPU. Optimized for Blazor WebAssembly and native GPU execution.

items.title: Introducing GPT-5.4 mini and nano
items.abstract: GPT-5.4 mini and nano are smaller, faster versions of GPT-5.4 optimized for coding, tool use, multimodal reasoning, and high-volume API and sub-agent workloads.

items.title: OpenAI Japan announces Japan Teen Safety Blueprint to put teen safety first
items.abstract: OpenAI Japan announces the Japan Teen Safety Blueprint, introducing stronger age protections, parental controls, and well-being safeguards for teens using generative AI.

items.title: Equipping workers with insights about compensation
items.abstract: New research shows Americans send nearly 3 million daily messages to ChatGPT asking about compensation and earnings, helping close the wage information gap.
